description: This file contains unit tests for local data store operations such as read, write, delete, and batch read in the context of the Orleans framework. It defines test classes, specific test methods, utility functions, and some supporting enums.

classes.name: ProviderType
classes.description: An enum defining different types of storage providers such as AzureTable, Memory, Mock, File, and AdoNet.

classes.name: LocalStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests targeting local data store operations like read, write, delete, and batch read within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: Store_Read
methods.description: Tests reading a row from the data store and validates the retrieved data against expected state properties.

methods.name: Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing a state to the store and then reading it back to verify data integrity and correctness.

methods.name: Store_Delete
methods.description: Tests deleting a row from the store, then verifying the row is no longer accessible, and re-writing the data.

methods.name: Store_ReadMulti
methods.description: Performs multiple row reads based on a common grain type, verifying multiple entries can be retrieved.

methods.name: GrainState_Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain's state, verifying data consistency.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Utility method to generate a list of key-value tuple identifiers for a grain, based on grain type and ID.

methods.name: AsDictionary
methods.description: Utility method to convert an object's properties into a dictionary.
